name: Circles at the Circus
source:
Your followers are crying out for you to destroy the circus that has arrived in town.  Investigate for yourself and decide whether you will wreck divine destruction on the establishment and its acts or ignore the pleas of your faithful.

[From [url=https://pandiaunderscore.itch.io/circles-at-the-circus]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的追随者大声呼吁你摧毁已经抵达镇上的马戏团。自己调查一下，然后决定是否要对这个机构及其行为进行神圣的毁灭，还是忽视信徒的恳求。

[来自[url=https://pandiaunderscore.itch.io/circles-at-the-circus]itch.io[/url]]
